description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of 'git reset --patch' functionality. It sets up a repository, makes changes, and verifies various reset scenarios and their outputs.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets up the repository state and saves it for later comparison.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD position for later verification.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp for subsequent commits.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a sequence of commands expecting success.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates writing lines of input for patch application.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the saved state matches the current repository state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the current state of a specific file or path.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the repository state to a specific commit or configuration.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the HEAD position has not changed unexpectedly.
